title: Clamshell RFID Cards
description: 125 kHz clamshell RFID cards for rugged access control and legacy proximity systems, with thicker ABS construction for repeated daily use.
summary: Clamshell RFID cards are thicker 125 kHz proximity credentials built for rugged, everyday access control use in offices, campuses, industrial sites and other legacy reader environments.
Clamshell style, which makes it durable and easy to carry.
The low frequency clamshell card can read up to 10 cm normally, even can100cm with specially matched readers.

faq.question: What are Clamshell RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for rugged low-frequency access cards in older proximity systems where thicker cards and dependable daily wear matter more than premium print finish.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Clamshell RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4200, TK4100, EM4305, T5577 Protocol: ISO14443 Frequency: 125khz Read Range: 5-120 cm, on long distance ID reader

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for Clamshell RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PPS, ABS, PVC Form Factor: Card format compatible with common access-control, ID, or NFC workflows. Dimensions: 85.5x54x1.8mm

faq.question: How can Clamshell RFID Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing: Silkscreen printing, offset printing, laser engrave with series number or UID number
